hook: A $30 board that boots straight into one game.
hookText: A Witness puzzle on an ESP32

beats.say: Steren built Circle with a Line, a standalone puzzle game inspired by The Witness, for Waveshare's one point eight inch ESP32 AMOLED touch board.
It is written in plain C on the ESP I D F framework, generates its puzzles procedurally, and synthesizes its own audio.
He says there is something genuinely incredible about holding a dedicated piece of hardware that boots straight into your personal app, all for about thirty dollars.
